complete_examples.text: Train-track-tunnel coupled system Green function Improved circle calculation method Differential quadrature finite element A B S T R A C T Aiming at the complexity of train-track-tunnel system, differential quadrature finite element (DQFEM) with both P-convergence and H-convergence is used to establish a refined dynamic model of train-track-tunnel coupled system.

In view of the complexity of the tunnel system and the inefficiency of the dynamic model of the train-track-tunnel system, DQFEM is adopted in this paper, which can better describe the tunnel structure and has both p-convergence and h-convergence.
